entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-07-31
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Test for outdated packages suggests the wrong version as the latest #55558
  • MTP artifact post-processing: a merged artifact can unlist unrelated artifacts sharing its extension #55555
  • Agentic workflow: detect build breaks and intermittent test failures and open tracking issues #55553
  • Create a dedicated pipeline for SDL checks #55552
  • Microsoft.DotNet.Cli.New.IntegrationTests.CommonTemplatesTests.FeaturesSupport: intermittent hang (test host hang-dump timeout, exit code 7) #55551
  • [dotnet test][MTP] Live output is duplicated by the exit-code summary's "Standard output" block #55549
  • NETSDKE2E][Regression] With .NET 11.0.100-preview.7.26379.122 installed by exe installer, failed to update the advertising manifest microsoft.net.workloads: Could not find a part of the path %appdata%\Local\Temp\2igunvgq.qkc\msi\dotnet\sdk-manifests when installing workloads #55548

Closed

  • Cannot createa universal macos binaries (x64+arm) #33469
    Backlog
  • Trace 'user sessions' in a first-class manner across GHA and AzDo #54446
  • Stop running build jobs on official builds #55544
  • BlazorWebAssemblyDiagnosticsEnabled cannot be set from a .csproj (conditions evaluated in Sdk.props) #55489
  • [NETSDKE2E] The implicit runtime (8.0/9.0/10.0) for NET11 preview 7 should be July update(8.0.29/9.0.18/10.0.10). #55490

PullRequests

Created

  • Emit NETSDK1244 warning when IncludeAllContentForSelfExtract is enabled #55559
  • Remove IdentityModel source-build workaround #55557
    Servicing-consider, Branch Lockdown
  • Document CI telemetry correlation requirements #55556
  • Close SDK-side gaps in MTP artifact post-processing #55554
  • [dotnet test][MTP] Don't replay live output in the exit-code summary #55550

Merged

  • Seed CLI telemetry session IDs from CI workflow context #54447
    Area-Telemetry
  • Stop running build jobs on official check-in CI runs #55547
  • Fix BlazorWebAssemblyDiagnosticsEnabled so it can be set from a .csproj #55537

Updated

  • [Experiment] Create a .NET SDK Issue Monster #55243
  • Enable cached file-based run in Native AOT CLI #55529
    Area-run-file
  • Add `dotnetup` Channel Intent Docs #55390
  • Onboard the Build Failure Analysis agentic workflow #55539
  • [release/10.0.1xx] Port template engine Helix consolidation (PR #53546) #55528
  • Replace nuget.org feed URLs with packagefeedproxy in tests #55463
  • Enable MSBuild-backed commands in the Native AOT CLI #55497
  • Fix fix-all correctness and authoring conformance across the .NET analyzers #55538
  • Fix NU5026: exclude PDB files from CopyProjectReferencesToPackage in TemplateLocator and Containers #54494
    stale
  • Migrate GenerateStaticWebAssetEndpointsManifest to IMultiThreadableTask #54706
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #55512
  • [release/10.0.1xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #55191
